schema.name: read_video
schema.description: Read a local video: automatically sample timestamped frames using inspect_images and transcribe speech with the desktop Volc ASR service when configured. Specify start_seconds/end_seconds for a segment or a closer follow-up. Each call covers at most 600 seconds and 1-6 sampled frames, not every moment; longer videos return next_start_seconds for continuation. Check audio.status and visual.status before claiming either was understood. transcribe=false reads only frames. Native image pixels follow session retention; a text-only main model can use the configured vision proxy. Never changes the source.

path.description: Local video path; relative to the session cwd

instruction.description: Question to answer from video frames and speech

end_seconds.description: Exclusive end, defaults to video end; paginated at 600 seconds

strategy.description: Same as inspect_images; omit for automatic selection
